name: Ball Cannon
design_intent:
TRIALS PHYSICS_PUZZLE proof course (v7_trials_challenge_types.md §2.4, owner example t_ball_cannon). A fuse bomb detonates and its radial blast PUNTS the resting Ball across a gap into the goal mouth. The clear-test is the SPORTS GoalZone latch (any goal_zone.scored). The Ball auto-resets to its spawn if a shot misses (settles/leaves bounds) so it can never be lost, and each reset ticks the attempt counter; gold = solve first blast.

DERIVED BLAST->BALL->GOAL (vs current Tuning explosion_impulse_center=1600, Ball mass 0.6, gravity 1600): the Ball rests at (400,1000) on a marshmallow launch pad (top 1060, ball radius 60). The bomb sits below-left at (300,1150); punt dir = (ball-bomb).normalized() = (0.555,-0.832) (up + slightly right), dist 180px. blast_radius 560 => linear falloff 0.679; with impulse_center 1500 the punt magnitude is 1500*0.679 = 1019, /mass 0.6 => launch velocity 1697 px/s = (vx 942, vy -1412). Projectile from (400,1000): apex ~623px up (y~377) at t~0.88s, descending through (1750,620) at t~1.43s -- dead-center of the goal mouth placed there (center 1750,620, w420 h560 => x 1540-1960, y 340-900). The intended one-blast solution lands in the goal.

The player spawns on a side pad at (900,1000), ~600px from the bomb (kill_radius 200) so the blast never kills them; the player has no traversal task here -- they read the arc and (in a fuller variant) can nudge the ball. The fuse recurs (~5.5s cadence) so a missed shot re-fires after the auto-reset returns the ball to spawn.

[HISTORICAL - v10 removed medals/par; binary completion] MEDAL (attempts, fewer better): gold 1 (first blast), silver 2, bronze 5.
